answer: Coordination-Clock Registry. An agent may act only after climbing a public terrace of timed checkpoints: each action requires solving a slot-specific delay puzzle derived from prior slots, so parallel identities cannot run ahead and must serialize through every checkpoint. A shared beacon broadcasts the current slot, and only actions whose jade token matches the slot are accepted — one identity, one lane. New identities cost the full serialized delay per slot, so N sybils pay N×wall-clock coordination time.
